[LLSU.4.1] The `logical` modifier on emit, the tick-fact infrastructure
that drives time-bound re-evaluation, and the operator-log
entries for retract causes.

| Name | Explanation | Dependencies | Refactor hint |
|---|---|---|---|
| `logical_emit` | `emit <Schema> logical` — truth-maintained fact | `emit_intratier` | use `emit` with an explicit TTL via `retain` and pair with an explicit-retract rule |
| `time_tick` | engine tick-fact plumbing for time-bound LHS tests | `logical_emit` | disable only if the tier has a natural high-frequency clock source |
| `logical_retract_observability` | operator-log entries for logical-retract cause (`justifier_end` / `hydration_ttl` / `explicit_retract`) | `logical_emit` | not generally avoidable for debuggability |
